name: Banh trang nuoc dua
summary: A Tam Quan rice cracker with coconut milk in the batter, eaten grilled and fragrant and rich from the coconut.
origin: Thị trấn Tam Quan, thị xã Hoài Nhơn.
taste: The portal says the coconut milk makes it fragrant and rich.
howToEat: Grill it, and eat it alongside other dishes.
seoTitle: Banh trang nuoc dua — Tam Quan coconut cracker
seoDescription: Bánh tráng nước dừa is a Tam Quan rice cracker made with coconut milk and eaten grilled, fragrant and rich.
